decisive_items: Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate that captures the underlying plasma cell dyscrasia with definitive marrow and paraprotein evidence. R4 reflects a secondary cryoglobulinemic phenomenon, while C1 is merely an append-only completion of R1 without independent diagnostic weight.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R1; adds no distinct diagnostic entity and relies on a single non-specific imaging finding.
